outputComponents.text:
Here is the faithful baseline reproduction of the **CURRENT UI (first-light blocker)** for `rebots-online/astronatally`:

### Replicated Baseline Details & Documented Quirks
- **Dimensions**: Precise 390px × 844px mobile viewport layout without browser chrome.
- **Atmospheric Scene**: Full candlelit fortune-teller room backdrop (`room.webp`) with deep plum, warm gold shelving, crystals, and the night window.
- **Top Header**: Deep near-black/plum bar (~76px) featuring the bottom-aligned underlined serif wordmark `Natally · the atelier` on the left, an oversized square customer portrait (~60–64px) at the upper right with status indicator, and the hamburger menu icon.
- **Ambient Indicator**: `Room sounds on` pill with pulse indicator at the upper-right room boundary.
- **Obstructing Welcome Modal**: Positioned at `y: 184px` and 350px wide with rounded 20px corners, completely occluding Natally in the background while re-displaying her likeness in the large circular mascot portrait (`natally-mascot.webp`) with the gold-to-plum gradient ring.
- **Typography & Verbatim Copy**:
  - Brass uppercase `FIRST LIGHT` subtitle.
  - Cream serif headline: *"Welcome to the atelier — I’m Natally."*
  - Verbatim serif greeting body text regarding birth chart details, cleared table space, and behaving candles.
  - Full-width brass/gold `Cast my first chart` CTA button.
  - Sub-caption regarding browser audio and headphones.
- **Version Stamp**: Outlined `v1.32.769` badge fixed at the lower right.

All observed UX defects (occlusion, duplicate avatar, wordiness, header imbalance) have been faithfully retained as your design reference baseline.

outputComponents.suggestion: Redesign the modal into a non-obstructing bottom sheet to reveal Natally
Optimize header proportions and reduce customer portrait size
Add interactive birth chart inputs directly into the atelier view
